# temps_node_alert_rule (Resource)

An alert on a node's resource usage or disk health. A node has at most one rule per metric: to manage a rule Temps already created (the control plane's defaults, a worker's disk-health rules), import it.

Temps refuses to delete the control plane's rules and a worker's disk-health rules, because it creates them again; destroying one of those disables it instead. Other rules are deleted.

Import with `<node_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_node_alert_rule" "worker_memory" {
  node_id           = 7
  name              = "Worker memory high"
  metric_name       = "node.memory_percent"
  threshold         = 90
  comparator        = ">"
  severity          = "warning"
  for_duration_secs = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comparator` (String) How the metric is compared with `threshold`. One of `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`.
- `metric_name` (String) Metric watched: `node.cpu_percent`, `node.memory_percent`, `node.disk_percent`, `node.raid_degraded`, `node.disk_wear_percent` or `node.disk_media_errors`.
- `name` (String) Name shown in notifications.
- `node_id` (Number) ID of the node; `0` is the control plane.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the alarm. One of `warning`, `critical`.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold: 0-100 for a usage percentage, 0 or more for a disk-health metric.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Evaluate the rule.
- `for_duration_secs` (Number) Seconds the breach must last before the alarm fires; `0` fires at once.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<node_id>/<id>`.
- `silenced_until` (String) Time the rule is silenced until, if it is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <node_id>/<id>; the control plane is node 0
terraform import temps_node_alert_rule.worker_memory 7/31
```
